Title: Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for early-July 2024

Body.Content:
In early-July 2024, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL:

  • Use database shrink to reduce allocated space in Azure SQL Database Hyperscale.
  • Simplify application migration to Azure SQL Managed Instance using Windows native principals.

Learn more.
